scores.claim_text: PowerCo SE (Volkswagen subsidiary) up to $130.7M collaboration; $130M IP-license royalty pre-pay contemplated. Goal: industrialize QSE-5.
scores.M_check: edgar_fts.query_fulltext for 'PowerCo' (114 hits, dominated by QS's own 8-K/10-Q/10-K and NOVONIX 6-Ks); 'QuantumScape' in 20-F/6-K (9 hits, all unrelated foreign filers Largo / Arrival / NOVONIX / Wallbox, none from Volkswagen AG)
scores.M_value: 0 mentions of QuantumScape in any Volkswagen / Volkswagen-affiliate filing on EDGAR. Foreign-filer caveat: VW does not file 20-F (German DAX-listed). No counterparty corroboration available via EDGAR.
scores.interpretation: Calibration #2 (foreign-issuer caveat) applies: Volkswagen Group is a German company that does NOT file SEC forms, so EDGAR cannot corroborate. Calibration #3 (stage ladder): QSE-5 is at B/B1 sample, NOT SOP. The amended Collaboration Agreement is a pre-SOP JDA. The PowerCo IP License Agreement and $130M pre-paid royalty have NOT yet been executed as of this filing — they remain conditional on milestone completion. Calibration #4: VW's $380M is largely equity investment, not a design-win. Calibration #11: the $19.5M received in 2025 was booked as APIC (capital contribution), not revenue, under ASC 730-20 — explicit acknowledgement of related-party R&D pattern. Pre-SOP stage + conditional milestones = MODERATE_UNDERDELIVERY relative to the marketing emphasis on the partnership.

scores.claim_text: QSE-5 B-samples achieve >800 Wh/L and 15-min 10-80% fast-charge; B1 demoed in Ducati V21L at IAA 2025.
scores.M_check: uspto_odp.query_assignee 'QuantumScape' with categorize buckets {solid_state, lithium, battery}
scores.M_value: 340 patent applications, 125 granted pre-cutoff. Category counts: solid_state=100, lithium=98, battery=55. Granted patents include garnet electrolytes, sintering equipment, ceramic separator, anode-free architectures — directly on the claimed technology stack.
scores.interpretation: Patent base is robust per Calibration Heuristic #8 (n_granted=125 >> 10 threshold, dominant in solid-state/lithium buckets) — PASS-quality on the IP-portfolio dimension. HOWEVER, Calibration Heuristic #9 (battery-specific energy-density disclosure quality) applies: the >800 Wh/L and 15-min fast-charge claims are stated WITHOUT explicit C-rate, temperature, depth-of-discharge in the disclosure excerpt. These remain B-sample numbers (not C-sample, not validation, not SOP). Stage-ladder discipline (Calibration #3) classifies this as a B-sample lab/cell-level claim, not a production cell claim. Net: MODERATE_UNDERDELIVERY on commercial-readiness implication despite verified IP.

scores.claim_text: Pre-revenue; FY2025 op loss $472.6M, net loss $435.1M, accumulated deficit $3.8B, ATM raises $264.2M FY25 + $128.5M FY24.
scores.M_check: edgar_fts.query_fulltext for 'ATM offering' CIK=QS (12 hits across FY23/24/25 10-Q and 10-K)
scores.M_value: Recurring ATM offering disclosures every quarter since 2023; FY2025 ATM raised $264.2M (29.5M shares), FY2024 $128.5M (24.9M shares), FY2023 $288.2M public offering. Cumulative dilution >91M shares from 2023-2025 alone. $970.8M cash on hand at YE2025 vs. ~$242M annual operating cash burn = ~4 years of runway absent further dilution.
scores.interpretation: Self-disclosure is fully corroborated by recurring EDGAR ATM filings. Calibration #10 (distress fingerprints) applies: ATM-driven cash funding model + listing transfer (NYSE->Nasdaq Dec 2025) + 16 years post-founding still pre-revenue (founded 2010) + 6 years post-deSPAC (2020) still pre-revenue. Accumulated deficit of $3.8B against ZERO commercial revenue is a hard signal of capital destruction. No going-concern qualifier (because of $970M cash) but the recurring ATM cadence implies indefinite repeated dilution. Calibration #10 elevates the severity of forward-revenue/SOP claims — score SEVERE_UNDERDELIVERY for the implied trajectory to commercialization.

scores.claim_text: Class A stock transferred from NYSE to Nasdaq effective Dec 23, 2025.
scores.M_check: edgar_fts.query_fulltext for 'Nasdaq' CIK=QS, forms 8-K,25-NSE (26 hits, including 2025-12-10 8-K announcing the transfer)
scores.M_value: Listing transfer 8-K filed 2025-12-10, transfer effective 2025-12-23. No 25-NSE delisting form, no Form 15-12G — voluntary transfer, not forced delisting.
scores.interpretation: Per the filing's plain language and the 8-K trail, this is a voluntary listing transfer, NOT a non-compliance delisting. However, voluntary mid-life NYSE->Nasdaq transfers by deSPAC companies are commonly associated with cost-saving / compliance-flexibility motives. Calibration #10 (delisting/going-concern fingerprints) treats this as a partial distress fingerprint: not a Form 15 / 25-NSE, but a non-routine event for a 5-year NYSE incumbent. Combined with QS-003 dilution pattern, score MODERATE_UNDERDELIVERY (not RED — the transfer was orderly and disclosed).

scores.claim_text: QS operates pilot manufacturing / cell-build line in San Jose, CA.
scores.M_value: 4 EPA-registered QuantumScape facilities in San Jose: 1730 Technology Dr (2x registry IDs), 1756 Automation Pkwy (QUANTUMSCAPE BLDG 4), 3087 N 1st St (QUANTUMSCAPE CORPORATION). All in Santa Clara County.
scores.interpretation: Calibration Heuristic #1 (EPA FRS scope for battery facilities) — pilot/production handling lithium and ceramic processing IS EPA-regulated for hazmat and air permits. Presence of 4 registry entries, including the named cell-build pilot building (1756 Automation Pkwy = the Exeter Automation lease per the 10-K exhibit list), confirms a real operational pilot footprint. PASS.

scores.claim_text: $19.5M received from PowerCo in FY2025 was booked as APIC capital contribution, not revenue, under ASC 730-20.
scores.M_check: Direct reading of Related Party Transactions note in the 10-K (no external M-source — the accounting treatment is self-evident from the filing and is forensically conservative).
scores.M_value: Note 11 (Related Party Transactions) explicitly accounts for PowerCo payments under ASC 730-20 with a presumption of repayment obligation due to related-party relationship; result is recognition as a capital contribution to Additional Paid-In Capital, no shares issued, no revenue.
scores.interpretation: Calibration #11 (revenue-recognition pattern, battery-specific) is satisfied by transparent disclosure: QS does NOT book the PowerCo Project payments as revenue, explicitly cites ASC 730-20 related-party R&D treatment, and acknowledges Volkswagen is a major investor. This is the conservative treatment the framework looks for; the absence of revenue-grossing-up of related-party JDA payments is a PASS. The fact that the Company has zero commercial revenue is captured separately in QS-003.

scores.claim_text: QS has signed sampling/JDA agreements with multiple unnamed OEMs ('leading manufacturers by global revenue to premium performance and luxury carmakers').
scores.M_value: Ford 10-K/10-Q/8-K: 0 mentions. GM 10-K/10-Q/8-K: 0 mentions. Stellantis 20-F/6-K/10-K: 0 mentions.
scores.interpretation: The claim refers to UNNAMED OEMs, so per Layer 3 Rule 7 (counterparty-disclosure threshold) we cannot definitively map the claim to a specific counterparty. The named OEMs not identified by QS (the filing only confirms Volkswagen/PowerCo by name) means absence in Ford/GM/Stellantis filings is consistent with QS-007 referring to other OEMs (potentially foreign filers — Toyota/Honda 20-F, BMW/Mercedes/Hyundai not in EDGAR). Calibration #2 (foreign-issuer caveat) applies broadly. The vagueness of the claim ('a number of OEMs', 'leading manufacturers') is itself a disclosure quality concern but is not a hard contradiction since QS does not name specific counterparties. Score UNVERIFIABLE per the framework's preference for acknowledging coverage gaps over false-clean.

scores.claim_text: Volkswagen has cumulative equity investment of ~$380M in QS since 2012.
scores.M_check: edgar_fts.query_fulltext 'Volkswagen' CIK=QS (94 hits across QS 10-K/10-Q/8-K/DEF 14A from 2020-2026)
scores.M_value: 94 self-disclosures of Volkswagen by QS across all SEC forms; investment amount, share ownership (Volkswagen historically held large Class B/voting stake from pre-IPO), and ongoing relationship consistently re-disclosed. No 13D/13G in EDGAR for VW because as a strategic investor on the board, VW filed via QS proxy materials rather than separate Schedules.
scores.interpretation: Calibration #4 (investment vs operating) is the key heuristic: $380M equity is real and consistently re-disclosed in QS's own filings, but it is an INVESTMENT, NOT a design-win, NOT a series-production commitment. The pattern of disclosing the equity investment alongside the PowerCo JDA (QS-001) is exactly the 'amplify perceived progress' pattern the framework flags. The investment is genuine; the framing as commercial validation is what gets discounted. Score MODERATE_UNDERDELIVERY (not RED — the equity is real and disclosed; the misdirection risk is in conflation with operational progress).
